name: bridge-tally
description: Read local Tally data and prepare Journals. Each new Journal posting requires a separate native approval.

host.title: Tally host
host.description: Loopback host of the local Tally instance (localhost, 127.0.0.1, or ::1).

port.title: Tally port
port.description: HTTP port of the local Tally instance.

redaction.title: Response redaction
redaction.description: Enter none, mask_parties, or drop_narration. Other values prevent the connector from starting.

enable_writes.title: Allow Journal posting
enable_writes.description: Journal preparation and posting are available by default. Every new posting requires approval in a native dialog; existing ledgers only. Turn off to use reads only.
